limitations.note: Replacing both enable ternaries with procedural `if` statements preserves behavior for known enables but holds the previous value for an X or Z enable, whereas the reference ternaries can propagate uncertainty in simulation.

limitations.quote: Diagnose cycle misalignment in Verilog and SystemVerilog state timers, sequence detectors, stream converters, and pipelines.
